verses.text: This is what the Lord GOD showed me: a basket of ripe summer fruit.

He asked, "Amos, what do you see?" I answered, "A basket of ripe summer fruit." Then the LORD said to me, "The time is ripe for my people Israel. The end has come. I will no longer pass over their sins.
On that day the songs in the temple will turn into wailing," says the Lord GOD. "There will be many dead bodies, thrown out everywhere in silence."
Listen to this, you who trample on the needy and try to wipe out the poor of the land!

You say, "When will the New Moon festival be over so we can sell grain? When will the Sabbath end so we can sell wheat? We will make the measures smaller and the prices bigger, and we will cheat with dishonest scales.
We will buy the poor for silver and the needy for a pair of sandals. We will even sell the husks with the wheat."
The LORD has sworn by the pride of Jacob: "I will never forget anything they have done.
Won't the land tremble because of this? Won't everyone who lives in it mourn? The whole land will rise like the Nile River. It will be tossed around and then sink again like the river of Egypt.
"On that day," says the Lord GOD, "I will make the sun go down at noon and darken the earth in broad daylight.

I will turn your festivals into mourning and all your songs into weeping. I will make all of you wear rough cloth and shave your heads. I will make it like the mourning for an only son, and its end like a bitter day.
"The days are coming," says the Lord GOD, "when I will send a famine through the land. It will not be a famine of food or a thirst for water, but a famine of hearing the words of the LORD.
People will stagger from sea to sea and wander from the north to the east, searching for the message of the LORD, but they will not find it.
On that day the beautiful young women and the strong young men will faint from thirst.
Those who swear by the shameful idol of Samaria, who say, 'As surely as your god lives, Dan,' or 'As surely as the god of Beersheba lives,' will fall, never to rise again."
